title: Zesty Korean Perilla Leaf Wrap
description: A refreshing and flavorful dish featuring perilla leaves, this wrap is perfect for a light lunch or snack, and its buddhist-temple-friendly ingredients make it a great option for those with dietary restrictions.
instructions: Rinse the perilla leaves and pat them dry with a paper towel.
Cut the tofu into small cubes and season with soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil.
Grate the ginger and mix it with the tofu.
Lay a corn husk flat and arrange 2 perilla leaves in the center.
Place a few pieces of the tofu mixture in the center of the perilla leaves.
Fold the perilla leaves over the filling to form a triangle, and secure with a toothpick if needed.
Repeat the process with the remaining ingredients.
To emulsify the sauce, whisk the soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil together in a small bowl.
Drizzle the emulsified sauce over the wraps before serving.
